distillation.title: Nuwa smart distillation
distillation.description: Name a subject and goal. The app collects public evidence and extracts mental models, decision heuristics, and expression DNA into an editable draft.
distillation.subjectPlaceholder: e.g. Paul Graham or scientific writing
distillation.briefPlaceholder: e.g. How they judge early products, with direct language and honest limits
distillation.draftHint: This is a draft — after applying, submit the form to save it.
distillation.limitedEvidence: Limited evidence — review the draft manually
distillation.searchBlockedHint: Public search is temporarily rate-limited. Try again later.
distillation.insufficientHint: Not enough public evidence. Try a better-known subject or add background to your goal.
distillation.modelConfigHint: No synthesis model configured. Set one up under Settings → Model management.
distillation.fetchFailedHint: Some sources could not be fetched. Retry later, or add the key material to your goal manually.
distillation.invalidOutputHint: The model returned an invalid draft. Retry — no partial result is saved.
distillation.outputTruncatedHint: The model's structured output was truncated. The system has adjusted its generation strategy; retry, or switch synthesis models if it keeps failing.
